# Turn a site day into a record you can review.

> Free private construction daily log and change order documentation tool for small contractors. Create a dated, reviewable evidence pack in your browser, saved locally so you can export a combined pack across the whole project.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [This evidence pack vs. Procore](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/construction-evidence-log/vs-procore.html)
